mode: Supplementary CPU source lifecycle using actual decoded source JPEG DataTexture fixtures; no WebGL renderer

dependencies.method: Fresh locked npm ci for runtime and sandbox in isolated git archive; see regressions-install-*.log

limitations: No GPU shader compilation or visual validation.
No authored FBX character or target rigs loaded: target collision/damage, ragdolls, clone appearances, bone-attached buffs, and character-animation presentation are not verified.
GLB mesh/animation parsing is real; embedded texture decode is unavailable in Node and may use upstream loader fallback.
Only default settings, a fixed valid cast, lifecycle and pooling/cancellation are exercised; arbitrary settings and gameplay balance are not certified.
The production browser bootstrap and URL asset-loading paths are not executed.
No target bodies; no authored character rig; no WebGL draw.

textureDecodeBoundary.method: Test-only TextureLoader interception for four exact source stone JPEG URLs. Actual Pillow-decoded RGBA8 bytes become Three DataTextures; source image dimensions and bytes are verified by SHA-256. Other URLs use original loader. No gameplay, source material, shader or setting is replaced.
textureDecodeBoundary.limitation: DataTexture substitutes decoded image transport. Browser JPEG/color decoding, GPU upload/mipmap generation, texture sampling and final appearance remain unverified.
